dialogs.about: 아침에 할아버지와 신문을 보며 선거 이야기를 해요

lines.en: Good morning. Did you read the headline today?
I have not read it. What does it say?
The election is next month.
I watched a debate on television last night.
Did you like the candidate?
Yes. Her speech was very clear then.
Will you vote for her?
I am not sure. I will think about it.
lines.ko: 잘 모르겠어요. 좀 더 생각해 볼게요.

lines.en: We will go to vote together on Wednesday.
Good. Thank you for telling me the news.
Excuse me. Is this the right place to vote?
Yes, Ma'am. Please show me your ID card.
Here it is. I came early this morning.
lines.ko: 여기 있어요. 오늘 아침 일찍 왔어요.

lines.en: Good. The line is short now.
Is the mayor on this paper too?
Yes. You choose one candidate for mayor.
lines.ko: 네. 시장 후보 한 사람을 고르시면 돼요.

lines.en: I do not know much about politics.
That is fine. The law keeps your vote safe.
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 법이 어르신의 표를 지켜 줘요.

lines.en: Thank you. Will they tell us the result tonight?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 오늘 밤에 결과를 알려 주나요?

lines.en: Yes. The election news will come tonight.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 밤에 선거 소식이 나올 거예요.
